title: Clean Configurable 3D Grid
description: Fix overlapping 3D grids so the viewport shows one clean regular grid, and expose the grid configuration in window options.
summary: Replaced the finite GridHelper geometry with one camera-following procedural infinite grid that fades completely before its mesh edge and camera far plane. Made orbit far clipping scale in stable power-of-two bands, removed the division/OOM path, and changed visual LOD spacing to preserve configured base spacing while targeting a much sparser roughly twenty-cell view density. Verified in the live Aggregator renderer and extended extreme-distance, fade, far-plane, and density tests.
